sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - Vector 9x19 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You're right on time, mercenary. If you've got the time, help me with a custom build. A high-profile client placed an order for a KRISS Vector submachine gun chambered in 9x19. It must have a Mk.5 Modular Rail, a Tactical Dynamics Skeletonized Foregrip, an optic or iron sights with an effective range of 300 meters, at least 33-round mag, and a suppressor. Ergonomics no lower than 48, combined recoil below 240. Once it's ready, I'll pay you."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify a KRISS Vector 9x19 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Personally, I prefer the forty-five version, but a Vector is a Vector! Excellent work."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
KRISS Vector 9x19 specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 48 or more ergonomics
- 240 or less recoil
- 300 or greater sighting range
- A silencer
- KRISS Vector Mk.5 modular rail
- Tactical Dynamics Skeletonized Foregrip
- Glock 9x19 "Big Stick" 33-round magazine

sections.heading: Build
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard KRISS Vector 9x19 from Skier LL3.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
